page.title: Co-pilot
page.subtitle: Explore your data. When a query runs, its SQL and result rows remain visible for review.

mode.guidedDescription: Shows a short, deterministic reading guide with the executed query and rows. No AI-generated conclusion is displayed.
mode.verifiedDescription: Shows only the validated SQL, row count, table, and deterministic chart. No generated interpretation is requested or displayed.
mode.verifiedCaveat: A valid query and its rows are evidence, but they do not automatically prove that a business conclusion is correct.
mode.adminHint: Choose the response style for everyone in this business. The change is audited.
mode.managedHint: An administrator sets this response style for the whole business.
mode.loadingDescription: Confirming the response contract configured for this business.
mode.updateError: We could not update the response mode.
mode.resultVerified: Verified-results response: no generated narrative was added.
mode.resultGuided: Review the executed SQL and displayed rows before using a figure. A valid query may answer the wrong question, and rows may be truncated.

chat.title: Conversation
chat.starter: Try: How much did I sell yesterday in Sur?
chat.resultReady: Results for your latest question are ready. View the queries and rows.

scope.label: Data scope
scope.allHint: A successful question uses one monthly Co-pilot allowance at each site.
scope.currentHint: Uses only this site's data and monthly allowance.
scope.unavailableHint: Wait until the current site is confirmed.

states.emptyDescription: Ask a question to see the query, rows, table, and available chart here.

results.noRows: No rows returned for this analysis.
results.truncated: The result was truncated to the server-side row limit.
